title: A connection between quaternionic slice regular and Fueter hyperholormorphic functions
summary: This paper presents some results for the slice regular functions and hyperholomorphic functions theories, as consequences of new relationships between the global operator $G$, Fueter operator $\mathcal D$ and Laplacian operator $Δ_{\mathbb{R}^{4}}$. Although our results are presented in the quaternionic setting, a fine interpretation in terms of vector calculus of the slice regular function theory yields an interesting relationship between this theory and harmonic analysis.
